newsitem.title: MEXICO: GM sees 22 pct more output at Mexico plant.
newsitem.headline: GM sees 22 pct more output at Mexico plant.

text.p: General Motors Corp said Friday that it expected output at its plant in Silao to reach 140,000 units in 1996, almost 22 percent more than in the previous year.
"Our production reports have been running at 12,000 units per month," a GM spokesperson said.
The Silao plant, which employs 3,500 workers, manufactures Suburban and Silverado light trucks, 85 percent of which are exported to the United States and Canada.
Last year's output of 115,000 vehicles generated revenue of about $900 million, the spokesman said.
